rules.description: Ensures all StatVars within each survey-year input share the same latest observation date.
Ensures historical single-year partitions match their expected survey years and 2024Onwards stays within the biennial CRDC publication lag.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS statvar_count, MIN(TRY_CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER)) AS min_year, MAX(TRY_CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)) AS max_year FROM stats
params.condition: statvar_count > 0 AND min_year IS NOT NULL AND max_year IS NOT NULL AND ((min_year IN (2012, 2014, 2018, 2021, 2022) AND max_year = min_year) OR (min_year = 2024 AND max_year >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 4))
